root.label: Complex Adaptive Systems & Complexity Theory
root.summary: Two highly interrelated knowledge domains exploring complex systems and their behavior.

cas.label: Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS)
cas.summary: A school of thought emphasizing crossing disciplinary boundaries and using computer simulation to understand self-organizing dynamics.

complexity_theory.label: Complexity Theory
complexity_theory.summary: Focuses on identifying and measuring complexity and its relationship to engineering systems.

cas_characteristics.label: CAS Characteristics
cas_characteristics.summary: Common characteristics of Complex Adaptive Systems.

cas_edge_of_chaos.label: Edge of Chaos
cas_edge_of_chaos.summary: CAS are balanced between order and anarchy, at the edge of chaos. (Waldrop, 1992)

cas_network_of_agents.label: Network of Agents
cas_network_of_agents.summary: CAS are composed of a network of many agents gathering information, learning and acting in parallel.

cas_coevolution.label: Coevolution
cas_coevolution.summary: The system co-evolves with its environment.

cas_emergent_order.label: Emergent Order
cas_emergent_order.summary: Order is emergent, instead of pre-determined, always unfolding and always in transition.

cas_hierarchical_levels.label: Hierarchical Levels
cas_hierarchical_levels.summary: CAS tend to exist in many levels of organization.

cas_unpredictability.label: Unpredictability
cas_unpredictability.summary: CAS have a future that is hard to predict.

cas_background.label: CAS Background
cas_background.summary: The historical roots and development of CAS.

santa_fe_institute.label: Santa Fe Institute
santa_fe_institute.summary: Founded in the mid-1980s, a think tank that fostered the development of CAS. (Dodder & Dare, 2000)

ilya_prigogine.label: Ilya Prigogine
ilya_prigogine.summary: Belgian Nobel laureate who explored self-organizing structures in nature since the 1960s. (Waldrop, 1992)

cas_applications.label: CAS Applications
cas_applications.summary: Applications of CAS thinking in various disciplines.

cas_physics.label: CAS in Physics
cas_physics.summary: Exploration of complexity in physics, exemplified by Murray Gell-Mann's work. (Dodder & Dare, 2000)

cas_biology.label: CAS in Biology
cas_biology.summary: Exploration of complexity in biology, exemplified by Stuart Kauffman's work. (Dodder & Dare, 2000)

cas_economics.label: CAS in Economics
cas_economics.summary: Application of complexity to economic systems, focusing on adaptation and nonlinear networks. (Dodder & Dare, 2000)

cas_political_science.label: CAS in Political Science
cas_political_science.summary: Application of complexity to political systems, using agent-based models. (Dodder & Dare, 2000)

complexity_identification.label: Identifying Complexity
complexity_identification.summary: Recognizing patterns of complexity in systems.

complexity_measurement.label: Measuring Complexity
complexity_measurement.summary: Approaches to quantifying complexity, considering knowledge and ignorance.

complexity_engineering.label: Complexity and Engineering Systems
complexity_engineering.summary: Applying complexity theory to engineering systems, focusing on modeling and control.
